symptom: A page parameter named `Context` (`Params: ( $Context: MyFirstModule.Sale )`) passed `check` and exec, and mx check reported CE7247 "The name 'Context' is a reserved word." at Page parameter 'Context' — after the page and its callers were written. The same for a snippet, Java action or JavaScript action parameter named with any platform-reserved word (`Type`, `Id`, `Owner`, `CurrentUser`, a Java keyword such as `Class`), and for anything named `Object`
cause: The platform reserved-word list (types.PlatformReservedWords) was applied to attribute names (MDL021) and enumeration values (MDL010) only; no validator looked at parameter names. The list also lacked `object`, which is CE7247 everywhere the list applies
file: `mdl/executor/validate_reserved_parameter_names.go` (validateReservedParameterNames, MDL-PARAM01, wired into ValidateProgram; refuseReservedParameterNames in execCreatePageV3, execCreateSnippetV3, execAlterPage, execCreateJavaAction, execCreateJavaScriptAction), `mdl/types/reserved_words.go` (+`object`)
insight: Measure which list applies WHERE, before reusing one: ~120 names × 6 contexts in three mx check runs on 11.13.0. Pages, snippets, Java actions and JavaScript actions share the attribute list exactly (case-insensitive, quoted refused) — every listed name tried was CE7247, every unlisted one clean, except `Object`, which nobody had listed because it is not a Java keyword (also CE7247 on an attribute, an enumeration value and an ENTITY). Microflow and nanoflow parameters and variables do NOT use it — `$Context`, `$Type`, `$Class` build clean there — and are refused for a different set: the system variables (CE0110 "Variable name 'latestError' is reserved." for currentObject/latestError/latestHttpResponse/latestSoapFault/currentSession/currentDeviceType, parameters and variables) and CE0039 for a variable named CurrentUser — not covered by this fix. Page VARIABLES named Context/Type/Object build clean too. Extending the shared list rather than adding a parallel one made MDL021/MDL010 pick up `Object` for free
